info.title: ScrapeBadger eBay API
info.description: eBay marketplace scraping API for searching active and completed (sold) listings, fetching item details, reviews, sellers, seller listings and feedback, category browsing, autocomplete, and reference data across 18 marketplaces.

get.description: Search an eBay marketplace for active listings.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: eBay marketplace domain TLD or alias (com, co.uk, de, fr, ...).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Restrict results to a category id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Results per page. Clamped to 60, 120 or 240.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort order for results.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Item condition. `graded` / `ungraded` are eBay's trading-card conditions — slabbed (PSA/BGS/CGC) vs raw — so a card can be priced separately from its slabs.

parameters.name: buying_format
parameters.description: Buying format filter.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price filter in the marketplace's local currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price filter in the marketplace's local currency.

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: Only return listings with free shipping.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Item location. `domestic` returns only items located in this marketplace's own country (`domain=fr` → France only); `worldwide` widens to every country. Foreign listings are priced in the marketplace's currency after eBay CONVERTS them, so `domestic` is also how you get untouched native sale prices.

current_bid.description: Current high bid for auction listings; mirrors `price`. Null for non-auction (fixed-price) listings.

sold_date.description: Sale date text as rendered by eBay on the sold card, e.g. "2 Jul 2026". Localized on non-English marketplaces (e.g. "Verkauft 5. Okt. 2024"). Null on active listings.

sold_date_at.description: Best-effort ISO 8601 date parsed from sold_date, e.g. "2026-07-02". Null when the marketplace's date format is not English.

is_sponsored.description: Always null — eBay renders its Sponsored badge into every card as anti-scraping bait, so promoted placements cannot be distinguished from organic results.

has_more.description: True while eBay still offers a next page — the stop signal for bulk extraction. total_results is populated on completed/sold; total_pages may be null. Past the last page eBay re-serves it, so page on has_more rather than looping until empty.

post.description: Search active listings by image, running eBay's own visual search — the camera icon in eBay's search bar. Returns the same shape as `/v1/ebay/search`, with `query` set to null. There is deliberately no `sort_by`: eBay ignores sorting on a visual results page. Costs 10 credits (two round trips to eBay); failed requests are free.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to search with. Exactly one of `image_url` or `image_base64` is required.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded. A bare payload or a `data:image/jpeg;base64,...` URL are both accepted. JPEG and PNG are verified; the decoded image must be at most 10 MB.

get.description: Search eBay completed (sold) listings — the closing prices buyers actually paid, with the date each item sold. `sold` is `true` on the envelope and each result's `price` is the final sold price. Served via an authenticated eBay session. Costs 5 credits; failed requests are free.

get.description: Get a single eBay listing's full detail.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The eBay listing item id.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: eBay marketplace domain TLD or alias (com, co.uk, de, fr, ...).

current_bid.description: Current high bid for auction listings; mirrors `price`. Null for non-auction (fixed-price) listings.

is_ended.description: True when the listing has closed (sold or ended), any buying format. Defaults to false.

end_time_utc.description: Listing end time as a Unix timestamp (float seconds): the auction close time, or the exact sold/ended time for ended listings of any format. Null for active fixed-price listings.

end_time_at.description: Listing end time as an ISO-8601 UTC string (e.g. "2026-06-22T19:50:51Z"): the auction close time, or the exact sold/ended time for ended listings of any format. Null for active fixed-price listings.

buy_it_now_price.description: Buy It Now price for fixed-price listings (mirrors `price`) or auction-with-Buy-It-Now listings. Null for pure auctions.
